answer: Small correction before I answer: that decade-long crew isn't really your current group anymore — after you moved across the country you rebuilt from scratch, and the people you actually see on weekends now are friends you've made in the last year or so. If you want to honor the old friendships this weekend, a long group video call, a shared photo thread of old trips, or even mailing a few of them something small works nicely across the distance. And with your local crew, this weekend is better spent on one of those low-key 1:1 hangs — a walk, a cook-together — since that history is still being built.
